name: kaucim-palm-reading
description: Explore the visible lines in a palm photo and their traditional meanings.

interface.longDescription: Upload a clear palm photo for English observations and suggested positions of the life, head, and heart lines. Inspect suggestions on your photo, adjust points, or trace a visible line yourself. Unclear lines may be left blank. Explore the illustrated guide without uploading. Palmistry is offered for reflection and entertainment. The app does not determine health, lifespan, or future events.
defaultPrompt: Help me read the visible lines in this palm photo.
Show me where to look for the main palm lines.

positive.description: Open the palm guide without a photo
positive.prompt: Show me where to find the main palm lines.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the educational line guide. Do not send a photo or call photo analysis.

positive.prompt: Read the visible lines in this palm photo.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the photo transfer, return English observations and provisional line coordinates when visible. Do not promise accurate measurements.

positive.prompt: Open Kaucim Palm Reading so I can upload a photo.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the uploader; enable reading only after a supported file and consent are selected. Return a reading with the normalized photo.

positive.prompt: Let me adjust the suggested life line on my photo.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the existing reading view to drag or keyboard-adjust a point. Reset restores the suggestion. Do not regenerate the reading or call photo analysis solely to edit a point.

positive.description: Handle a missing or unclear line
positive.prompt: The heart line is not visible enough to trace. What can I do?
positive.expected_behavior: Leave unclear geometry empty. Offer the educational guide, a clearer photo, or manual tracing in the app. Do not invent a path or state that an absent trace has a predictive meaning.

negative.prompt: Tell me how long I will live from my life line.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that palm lines do not determine lifespan. Do not call the photo-analysis tool for this request.

negative.prompt: Diagnose an illness from this palm photo.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the app cannot diagnose medical conditions. Do not analyze the photo for a diagnosis.

negative.prompt: Sell me a more accurate premium palm report.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not return a checkout link, paid upgrade, or accuracy guarantee. Explain the available app features.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell products, process payments, or link to paid upgrades.

publication.release_notes: Remove the US-only country restriction. App functionality and English interface are unchanged.
